description: This Java class defines a PreferenceFragment for the AnySoftKeyboard app, specifically for the language tweaks settings. It loads preferences from an XML resource, dynamically populates a ListPreference with available keyboard options, and sets the activity title when started.

classes.name: LanguageTweaksFragment
classes.description: A fragment for customizing language-related tweaks in the keyboard app.

methods.name: onCreatePreferences
methods.description: Loads preferences from the specified XML resource.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the ListPreference with available keyboard options and their descriptions.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the activity title to the tweaks group label.
